Titz and Clarke on Aberdeen shortlist - gossip
- Published
Former Scotland boss Steve Clarke and former Hannover manager Christian Titz are on a seven-man shortlist to replace Stephen Robinson at Aberdeen, along with recently sacked Burnley manager Nicky Hayen. (Sky Sports), external
Despite Aberdeen's interest, Clarke is understood to be settled in London, while Falkirk manager John McGlynn is keen to remain with the Bairns. (Press and Journal), external
In-form Rangers striker Ryan Naderi would not be interested in a January move to English Championship side West Ham United. (Football Insider), external
Torino midfielder Gvidas Gineitis was stung by Celtic's inability to agree a fee for him in the summer, but could be available in January for about €10m. (TuttoMercatoWeb - in Italian), external
Dundee will receive an add-on fee from Stoke City for former defender Luke Graham after the 22-year-old made his first Scotland start on Friday. (Courier), external
Dundee United defender Michael Forbes is determined to break into the Northern Ireland starting XI after an impressive start to life at Tannadice. (Courier), external
